testCase.name: [本地] S13 Silence, ward noise and a cough produce no words

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S13 「静音、病房噪音和咳嗽不产生任何字」 Silence, ward noise and a cough produce no words

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Nothing that was not dictated appears in the transcript: no words invented on silence or noise, no unit added to a bare value.（UAT 3.4）
  • T10 No finding, judgment or normal appears in the output unless it was dictated (Principle 1); for TC-23, the vocabulary hint's findings and normals (afebrile, normotensive, no JVD, oriented times three, …（TFA-94229 R8） — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Same setup as S01; both the live engine and the whisper-1 recovery engine; Z-01 and Z-03 also on the Nursing Home Pre-Round box and Encounter Dictate

When Dictate 10 s of silence; 10 s of synthetic ward noise with no speech; H-03 followed by 8 s of silence; H-03 with a cough in the middle

Then Silence and noise leave the box unchanged; the trailing silence adds nothing after H-03; the cough becomes no word

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U7 / 3.4: any word that was not dictated is a Fail (typical: 'Thank you', 'you', 'Bye', subtitle credits), quoted; any term from the vocabulary hint (DEFAULT_MEDICAL_HINT: afebrile, normotensive, no JVD, oriented times three, WBC decreasing…) that was not dictated counts as an invented finding or normal (T10, gated); H-03 items keep their S01 checks (numbers, boundaries)

在哪跑：本地 aicheck-dictation（口述 AI 检查）；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S13 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-23.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：测试问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94229 in progress

还没判：安静、病房噪音、咳嗽会不会被转出字来，卡在同一个 OpenAI key 许可上。

Not judged yet: whether silence, ward noise or a cough produce made-up words is blocked on the same OpenAI key approval.

依据：allure-results/21171771…: fixtures are built under cases/fixtures/tc23/; blocked by the same key precondition.

重复：和 TC-23/S01 是同一个问题，看那条（保留的）；这条带标签「重复」，筛选时可以去掉。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane aicheck-dictation。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：aicheck-dictation。

UAT item: TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-23/S13

Silence, ward noise and a cough produce no words

Tickets: TFA-94229 Port & preserve Vikram's clinical AI logic (in progress)

本地新 lane aicheck-dictation：aicheck-dictation/results.json 里 status blocked → 卡住（卡住）。

怎么测（aicheck-dictation/plan.json，automatable: yes）：fixture WAVs under cases/fixtures/tc23/ (silence-10s, ward-noise-10s from beeps + speech-shaped noise, H-03 + 8 s silence, H-03 with a synthetic cough); live transport through the box and batch through transcribeAudio; emptyTranscript and hint-term checks. — Engine behaviour on silence/noise is the point; key precondition only. Fixtures built.

Detail:

laneB-preconditions not met: the local OPENAI_API_KEY ends …PUMA and there is no OK on record from Quinn that it is not the key dev uses (her 2026-10-09 notes say it may be), so no audio was sent to OpenAI. Run after that OK: QA_DICT_MODE=live QA_DICTATION_LIVE_OK=PUMA scripts/aicheck-dictation/run.sh. harness self-test with the scripted far end: 6/6 takes landed in the box and passed the checks (shim, Dictate/Stop, read rule, engine attribution, checks.ts). The scripted self-test behind this entry ran before the review fix and used the real prepareSession: each take minted one OpenAI client secret (client.realtime.clientSecrets.create on api.openai.com) with the local key …PUMA — no audio, but the gated key was used. Fixtures built under cases/fixtures/tc23/ (silence-10s, ward-noise-10s, H-03-trailing-silence, H-03-cough); the batch half is scripts/aicheck-dictation/batch-transcribe.ts S13.

证据：附了 1 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (dictation-ai runner, not built): it plays a fixed synthetic voice into the app's own Dictate through a getUserMedia shim (no real microphone or speaker) on a fresh @roundai.test account, spending the local OpenAI key (laneB-preconditions).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
